g:HTMLPanel.p: Show or hide a widget per breakpoint with visibleOn and hiddenOn, which write Bootstrap's d-*-block and d-*-none classes.

d:Example.heading: Hide from a breakpoint up
d:Example.description: `hiddenOn="MD"` writes `d-md-none`: the widget hides from that breakpoint up. Resize the window to see the badges change.

d:Example.heading: Show from a breakpoint up
d:Example.description: Hide the widget everywhere with `hiddenOn="XS"` and show it again from a breakpoint up with `visibleOn`.

d:Example.heading: Print
d:Example.description: `PRINT` controls what shows when the page is printed.
